bio.text: Brent Taylor, a Republican, is a Tennessee state senator for District 31 and won the Republican primary in August 2026 for Tennessee's 9th Congressional District.

The Tennessee General Assembly's member page lists the Memphis City Council, the Shelby County Commission and the Shelby County Election Commission among his civic roles, and describes him as a funeral director and former president and CEO of Brentwood Funeral Services.
The Tennessee Lookout reports that he lives in Eads, in Shelby County, and is a former funeral home director.

sources.title: Tennessee US House District 9: Republican Taylor and Democrat Pearson set for general election
